purpose: Compare a level or condition to a familiar standard.
keywords: N + 並み / 並みの / 並みに
His skill is at a professional level.
Heat like midsummer keeps continuing this year.
The newcomer works at the same level as the experienced staff.
formation: N + 並み / 並みの / 並みに
restrictions: Used for ability, size, price, or treatment.
mistake: It refers to a comparable level, not literal identity.
